Nature, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03314-6

Record-breaking avalanches and floods are signs of things to come. Scientists must evaluate and respond to growing risks in mountain regions.

Nature.title: Toxic chemicals in fentanyl revealed by speedy technique
Nature.summary:
Nature, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03317-3

Chemical fingerprinting charts the rises and declines of specific adulterants in illicit supplies of the drug.
